contents.text: The agent asks before it sends. Nothing leaves the page until the visitor says yes. Then the request reaches you once, so you never get the same booking twice.

choices.label: It shows what each answer cost
choices.why: The last of the four: every answer's cost, shown in rand.

choices.why: Pick any part of the page by its name.
